color_tint.label: Tint with track color
color_tint.description: Recolor the visualizer toward the current track's dominant artwork color.

show_on_dashboards.label: Show on dashboards and cast displays
show_on_dashboards.description: Render the visualizer on the party screen and on dashboards cast to a TV or display. Those screens sign in as a viewer with no settings of their own, so this decides for them. Your own choice in the player menu always takes precedence on your own session.
